name: barbell standing bradford press
description: A standing Bradford press, lifting the bar from the front of the shoulders to behind the head and back. Works the delts.
instructions: Stand tall with the bar at the front of your shoulders and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Press the bar only high enough to clear your head, without locking your elbows fully.
Move your head gently forward and lower the bar behind your head to a comfortable depth.
Press it back over your head and lower it to the front rack to complete one cycle.
Keep your trunk braced and use a light load.
